lines: // The tank the player sits in: the script API cannot ask what a player rides, so the
// nearest tank right under the player stands in for it.
// Using the Firing Lever in a tank fires a shell where the driver looks.
player.showActionBar("Get in a Mini Tank to fire.");
const hit = player.raycast(RANGE, { entities: true, ignore: tank });
const target = hit !== undefined ? hit.pos : eyes.offset(look.x * RANGE, look.y * RANGE, look.z * RANGE);
const distance = hit !== undefined ? hit.distance : RANGE;
const at = eyes.offset(look.x * step, look.y * step, look.z * step);
// Using an iron ingot on a damaged tank repairs it by five hearts.

meta.notes: The tank's cannon and repairs. Using the Firing Lever while sitting in a tank casts a ray from the driver's eyes (raycast, passing through the tank), draws a smoke trail along it and makes an explosion of power 2.5 where it stops, up to 48 blocks away; the explosion hurts mobs but breaks no blocks. player.data keeps the reload time, three seconds. The script cannot ask what a player rides, so a tank just under the player counts as theirs. Using an iron ingot on a damaged tank heals it by ten health. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export.
